source.title: Legion MBT
source.author: RGriffin65
source.notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 2, 2026-10-30), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. TRACKED. The kit's hull was split by `tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py` (legion_prep.json) into the hull, the turret (`Legion_turret`, turns about its dome centre), the two big barrels with their small flanking ones (`gun`, a node the original lacks: weapon_01 re-parented under it; the original's weapon_02..04 are side pods on the turret and stay on it) and two track belts (the faces within 140 mm of the closed belt path round the wheels). The 7 wheels a side (`wheel_l0`..`wheel_r6`: 6 road wheels and the rear sprocket) are OWN GEOMETRY (`make_wheel`) on axles fitted to the skirt cut-outs; the kit's wheel faces were cut from the hull. Belts on a tread strip of two link pitches (0.44 m). welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 8 degrees, no collapse.

tracks_note: both belts share one tread strip (v0, v_len, belt_m): veh_lowpoly.py maps each belt's arclength modulo belt_m (2 link pitches) into it, track_l in the left half of the atlas strip, track_r in the right; v increases toward the rear on the visible ground run
